reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with NormedAddCommGroup, InnerProductSpace R, FiniteDimensional R, MeasurableSpace and BorelSpace instances and canonical Lebesgue volume; dimension zero is allowed. Let V:E->R, alpha,beta:NNReal and eta:R. Assume alpha cast to R is strictly positive, alpha<=beta, V is C2, and for every x,a in E,
  alpha*||a||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x a) a <= beta*||a||^2.
Assume eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. Define actual measures and potential by
  mu=volume.tilted(x->-V(x)),
  J=map((x,g)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)*g),mu.prod(stdGaussian E)),
  W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+||z-y||^2/(8*eta).
The tilt of -F is exp(-F)/integral exp(-F) times volume; positive normalization is not built into the definition. The Gaussian is the actual standard real Hilbert Gaussian and the product and pushforward are actual independent product and map.
There exist kernels R,S:E->Measure E such that R and S are Markov kernels, R disintegrates the swapped actual joint J.map Prod.swap, and for every y in E, S(y)=(R(y)).map(x->2*x-y).
For every y in E, S(y)=volume.tilted(z->-W_y(z)), W_y is C2, exp(-W_y) is Lebesgue integrable, and its Lebesgue integral is strictly positive. For this y there exists a real-linear partial operator D:L2(S(y);R)->L2(S(y);E) with dense domain in scalar L2(S(y)), D closable and D.closure closed, and with the exact graph characterization: for every scalar class a and vector class H, (a,H) belongs to graph(D) iff there exists a smooth compactly supported phi:E->R with a=phi S(y)-almost everywhere and H=gradient(phi) S(y)-almost everywhere.
For each y this same D is chosen before epsilon and f.
For every real epsilon>0 and every f in L2(S(y);R), there exists u in D.closure.domain satisfying all conclusions below simultaneously. Write u_rep and f_rep for the standard measurable representatives of the actual scalar L2 classes, and G_rep for the standard representative of G=D.closure(u) in L2(S(y);E). Abbreviate the exact scalar expression by
  r(x)=epsilon*u_rep(x)+<gradient(W_y)(x),G_rep(x)>_E-f_rep(x).
(a) For every z in D.closure.domain,
  epsilon*<u,z>_{L2(S(y);R)}+<D.closure(u),D.closure(z)>_{L2(S(y);E)}=<f,z>_{L2(S(y);R)}.
(b) u_rep and G_rep are locally integrable with respect to Lebesgue volume.
(c) For every C1 compactly supported psi:E->R and every direction a in E, both x->psi(x)*<G_rep(x),a>_E and x->u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) are Lebesgue integrable, and
  integral psi(x)*<G_rep(x),a>_E dx = - integral u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) dx.
(d) The real scalar function x->||r(x)||^2 is locally Lebesgue integrable.
(e) For every compact set K in E, u_rep, G_rep and r each satisfy MemLp at exponent 2 with respect to volume.restrict K, including a.e. strong measurability and finite L2 norm for that actual restricted measure.
(f) For every C2 compactly supported phi:E->R, the two functions x->u_rep(x)*Laplacian.laplacian(phi)(x) and x->r(x)*phi(x) are Lebesgue integrable and
  integral u_rep(x)*Laplacian.laplacian(phi)(x) dx = integral r(x)*phi(x) dx.
(g) For every C2 compactly supported chi:E->R, define the following actual functions, with the notation v_chi corresponding to the let-defined v in the statement:
  v_chi(x)=chi(x)*u_rep(x),
  G_chi(x)=chi(x) scalar-multiplied by G_rep(x) + u_rep(x) scalar-multiplied by gradient(chi)(x),
  F_chi(x)=chi(x)*r(x)+2*<gradient(chi)(x),G_rep(x)>_E+u_rep(x)*Laplacian.laplacian(chi)(x).
Then v_chi, G_chi and F_chi each satisfy MemLp at exponent 2 with respect to the full volume measure, with actual a.e. strong measurability and finite global L2 norm. All three topological supports are contained in the topological support of chi:
  tsupport(v_chi) subset tsupport(chi),
  tsupport(G_chi) subset tsupport(chi),
  tsupport(F_chi) subset tsupport(chi).
For every C1 compactly supported psi:E->R and every a in E, both x->psi(x)*<G_chi(x),a>_E and x->v_chi(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) are Lebesgue integrable, and
  integral psi(x)*<G_chi(x),a>_E dx = - integral v_chi(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) dx.
For every C2 compactly supported phi:E->R, both x->v_chi(x)*Laplacian.laplacian(phi)(x) and x->F_chi(x)*phi(x) are Lebesgue integrable, and
  integral v_chi(x)*Laplacian.laplacian(phi)(x) dx = integral F_chi(x)*phi(x) dx.
All unannotated local-integrability, integrability and integral assertions use canonical Lebesgue volume. The Hilbert inner products use the actual law S(y). Laplacian.laplacian on chi and phi is the actual finite-basis test-function trace; no classical Laplacian of the arbitrary representative u_rep or v_chi is asserted. The same u and G serve every test and every cutoff. chi is any real C2 compact-support function, without positivity, value-range or plateau assumptions. The localized functions are given by these three formulas, not independent existential choices; no membership of v_chi in a weighted partial-operator domain is asserted.
One R,S pair works for all y, and every y has the potential/density identity and a suitable D; these conclusions are not limited to almost every y. Conditional disintegration has its usual scope and does not assert this for every possible version of R on exceptional y. D is selected fiberwise once and works for all epsilon>0 and all scalar L2 forcing f; u is chosen before every cutoff chi. There is no joint measurable y-dependent D or u selection, uniqueness, H2 or classical-Laplacian conclusion, core characterization, invariance/iteration or quantitative bound.
objects: C2 potential V with NNReal alpha,beta and real eta; actual normalized Gibbs tilt mu; actual Gaussian independent product/noisy joint J and midpoint-quadratic W_y; Markov R,S with true swapped-joint conditional disintegration and reflection pushforward; fiberwise dense closable partial gradient D and closed closure on actual L2(S y); epsilon, forcing f, original solution u/G/residual r; compact restrictions, C1/C2 tests and all explicit localized cutoff objects.
domains: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space E with canonical volume, including dimension zero. Scalar and vector Lp at exponent 2 are actual L2 quotients, whose coercions are the standard measurable representatives. D is a real-linear partial operator on a submodule domain; u and variational tests belong to D.closure.domain. Original G is the actual representative of D.closure(u), not a separately selected weak-gradient witness. Unannotated integrability and integrals use volume; compact L2 restrictions explicitly use volume.restrict K. Localized v_chi,F_chi:E->R and G_chi:E->E are actual formula-defined functions with global MemLp 2 volume. C1 gradient tests and C2 PDE tests/cutoffs have compact topological support. Laplacian of test/cutoff is the actual finite-basis trace. For each y original L2 classes and Hilbert inner products use S y. mu=volume.tilted(-V); J maps (x,g) to (x,x+sqrt(eta)*g) under mu.prod(stdGaussian E); W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+||z-y||^2/(8*eta). Markov kernels are genuine measurable probability transitions. R disintegrates J.map Prod.swap; S y is its reflection pushforward and the actual normalized tilt of -W_y.
quantifiers: Universally over E instances,V,NNReal alpha,beta,eta satisfying premises; Hessian inequalities forall x,a. After lets mu,J,W exists one R,S pair; reflection identity forall y and full potential/operator/solution block forall y. For each y exists one D, before forall epsilon>0 and forall scalar L2(S y) f; graph iff forall a,H with exists smooth compact generator. For each epsilon,f exists u before every closure-domain variational test, original C1 directional tests, compact K, original C2 distribution tests and all C2 compact cutoffs chi. Each chi has three exact lets followed by localized C1 directional and C2 distribution universal tests. No y-a.e. weakening or joint measurable selector appears.
assumptions: Displayed NormedAddCommGroup, real InnerProductSpace, finite dimension, MeasurableSpace, BorelSpace and approved volume, including dimension zero; alpha,beta NNReal, alpha cast>0, alpha<=beta; V C2; forall x,a, alpha*||a||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R V) x a) a <= beta*||a||^2; eta>0 and beta*eta<=1. D density, closability, closed closure, exact graph, W_y integrability and positive partition are conclusions, not premises. epsilon positive; f only actual scalar L2(S y). Cutoffs only C2 compact support; test regularity C1 or C2 as stated.
conclusion: Exists R,S both Markov, R a conditional kernel for the swapped actual J, S y the pushforward of R y under x->2*x-y for every y. For every y, S y=volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y C2, exp(-W_y) volume-integrable with strictly positive integral; exists dense-domain closable scalar-to-vector D with closed closure and exact smooth compact gradient graph modulo S y. One selected closure-domain u satisfies the Hilbert variational equation for all closure-domain tests; volume local integrability of original u_rep/G_rep; for every C1 compact test and every direction the two L1 products and ordinary weak-gradient equation with minus sign; local volume integrability of ||r||^2; MemLp 2 (volume.restrict K) for u_rep,G_rep,r for every compact K; for every C2 compact test the two L1 products and unweighted positive-sign equation integral u_rep*Delta(phi)=integral r*phi. For every C2 compact cutoff chi, let v_chi=chi*u_rep, G_chi=chi scalar-multiplied by G_rep + u_rep scalar-multiplied by gradient chi, and F_chi=chi*r + 2*<gradient chi,G_rep> + u_rep*Delta chi. All three are actual global MemLp 2 volume and each topological support is contained in tsupport chi. For every C1 compact psi and direction a, both psi*<G_chi,a> and v_chi*Dpsi[a] are volume-integrable and integral psi*<G_chi,a>=-integral v_chi*Dpsi[a]. For every C2 compact phi both v_chi*Delta phi and F_chi*phi are volume-integrable and integral v_chi*Delta phi=integral F_chi*phi. Every integrability assertion is retained separately from the equations. Here r=epsilon*u_rep+<gradient(W_y),G_rep>-f_rep.
scopes: One R,S pair serves all y. Each y has one D serving every positive epsilon/forcing; each epsilon/f yields one u serving all tests and cutoffs. True conditional-kernel property retains usual disintegration scope and does not quantify over every conditional version on every y. Scalar/vector representatives and original G come from the actual quotient/closure. Volume conclusions are ordinary unweighted integrals, distinct from S y Hilbert inner products. Localized v_chi/G_chi/F_chi use actual original representatives and fixed formulas, with global volume L2 and support inclusions. No localized weighted-domain assertion, pointwise total Laplacian u, H2, core theorem, joint measurable y selection, uniqueness, invariance or iteration result is an explicit conclusion.
constant_dependencies: Exact alpha>0, beta>=alpha as NNReal, eta>0 and beta*eta<=1; joint sqrt(eta), reflection 2, midpoint 1/2, potential penalty denominator 8*eta. epsilon any positive real. Residual +epsilon,+1,-1 and localization chi*r + 2*<gradient chi,G> + u*Delta chi use positive 2 and unit coefficients exactly. Global/restricted L2 exponent and residual norm-square exponent are 2. Kernels depend on outer data, D may depend on y and S y, u on y,D,epsilon,f; same u/G precede all chi/test choices. No unspecified numerical estimate constant.
